<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
.cb-grad{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#a1a1aa 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
.cb-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:all .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.cb-reveal.cb-on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.cb-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;z-index:1}
.cb-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.85),transparent);transition:left .6s ease;z-index:-1}
.cb-btn:hover::before{left:100%}
@keyframes cb-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0)}}
.cb-pulse{animation:cb-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) infinite}
.cb-ambient{position:absolute;width:600px;height:600px;left:50%;top:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(79,70,229,.4) 0%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(80px);opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
@keyframes cb-spin{100%{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.cb-cta-spin{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cb-cta-spin::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-50%;width:200%;height:200%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%,transparent 0%,rgba(79,70,229,.12) 50%,transparent 100%);animation:cb-spin 10s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes cb-slide-up{to{transform:translateY(0)}}
.cb-sticky{transform:translateY(100%);animation:cb-slide-up .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards 1.5s}
.cb-play{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:80px;height:80px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;transition:all .3s ease;z-index:3}
.cb-wrapper:hover .cb-play{background:#fff;color:#000;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1)}
.cb-faq{background:#0a0a0f;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
.cb-faq-q{padding:22px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;color:#ffffff;text-align:left}
.cb-faq-q::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.cb-faq-q::after{content:'+';color:#818cf8;font-size:24px;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s;margin-left:16px}
details[open].cb-faq .cb-faq-q::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.cb-faq-a{color:#a1a1aa;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;padding:0 24px 20px}
.cb-timer{font-family:monospace;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#ef4444;background:rgba(239,68,68,.12);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:2px}
</style>
body_html:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
 var r=document.querySelectorAll('.cb-reveal');
 if(!('IntersectionObserver'in window)){r.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('cb-on');});}
 else{var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(en){if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('cb-on');io.unobserve(en.target);}});},{threshold:0.1});
 r.forEach(function(e){io.observe(e);});}
 var t=document.getElementById('cb-timer');
 if(t){var s=15*60;setInterval(function(){s--;if(s<0)s=0;var m=String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0');var ss=String(s%60).padStart(2,'0');t.textContent=m+':'+ss;},1000);}
});
</script>
